items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation
to allowing Suffolk off-track betting corporations to host additional video
lottery gaming devices
items.lawSection: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7685

SPONSOR: GAUGHRAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in
relation to allowing Suffolk off-track betting corporations to host
additional video lottery gaming devices

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The purpose of this legislation is to allow the Suffolk off-track
betting corporation to install and operate up to 2,000 video lottery
gaming terminals.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Amends Section 503 of the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and
breeding law by adding a new subdivision 10-a.

Section 2: Sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Under current New York State law, the Suffolk region off-track betting
corporation is only permitted to install and operate up to 1,000 video
lottery gaming devices. This bill would give the corporation the ability
to install and operate up to 2,000 video lottery gaming devices, which
estimates show could possibly generate over twice as much funding for
State education.

Specifically, it has been estimated that Suffolk County alone could
receive an additional $15,000,000 to $20,000,000 in much needed recur-
ring annual revenue. The facility housing these devices in Suffolk Coun-
ty has one of the highest Win Per Unit (WPU) rates in both New York
State and the country, generating upwards of $100,000,000 in funding for
State education.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

No cost to the state. However, it is estimated that this act will gener-
ate millions of dollars in revenue for Suffolk County as well as the
state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the first of January next succeeding the
date on which it shall have become a law.
